name: load_track
description: Load a local GPX file. IDs live for this server process.

name: summarize_track
description: Summarize original geometry without connecting segment gaps.

name: inspect_track
description: Inspect an original point by zero-based index, or the nearest recorded point at distance_m. Supply exactly one selector.

name: render_map
description: Render plain terminal text, with no control sequences. Omit track_id for a basemap without a route. Defaults to Mapbox when a runtime access token is configured, otherwise an empty canvas with only imported geometry. Use provider none to skip Mapbox requests. Missing Mapbox credentials are reported in scene status. Without a track or camera options, starts at longitude/latitude 0 and zoom 0. Width/height describe the map viewport in cells.
